notes: All 12 searches used. Search summaries blend pages, so symptom/urgency sentences are attributed to the NHS pages returned (111.wales.nhs.uk, nhs.uk kidney infection and cystitis) with that caveat. Cut: Danish audit, dementia imaging, stones/devices, quarter-to-a-third recurrence, systematic-review 'no benefit', Gloucestershire leaflet claims, premature delivery, surgery, 'symptoms return after antibiotics', 'no symptoms at all' in children, blood in urine in older children, pregnancy in NHS urgent list. Kept in final but flag for reviewer: '48 hours' and 'up to six months' are durations quoted from NHS 111 Wales, not doses; 'very high or very low temperature' states no numeric cut-off. NHS inform advises against NSAIDs for UTI while other NHS leaflets allow ibuprofen for lower UTI; final text only mentions ibuprofen avoidance for kidney infection per NHS. Dipstick/NICE QS260 and UK hospital study sentences rest on PMC search summaries (PMC8336295, PMC6498584) quoting NICE; article-level attribution blended. Existing conditions.json entry mentions nitrofurantoin/trimethoprim and a single post-sex antibiotic dose; final avoids naming drugs. No contradiction with existing entry found.
